pair_metrics.effect_sign_accuracy: fraction of non-tied true pair deltas whose predicted delta has the same nonzero sign
pair_metrics.effect_magnitude_mae: mean absolute error in pairwise utility delta
pair_metrics.kendall_tau_b: Kendall tau-b: C and D are concordant/discordant pairs; T_true counts every pair tied under true effects; T_pred counts every pair tied under predicted effects; tau_b=(C-D)/sqrt((n-T_true)*(n-T_pred)), with n=covered pairs. Ties on both sides count in both T_true and T_pred.
pair_metrics.top1_regret: best true utility in the frozen action bank minus selected action true utility, floored at zero
pair_metrics.null_false_effect_rate: fraction of covered pairs predicted nonzero when true scenario effect is identically zero

denominator_policy: emit per-metric defined episode count; null metric count=0; no confidence interval below two independent histories; report branch-outcome and branch-state defined episode counts separately; pairwise-effect-only predictor has no absolute branch-error denominator

action_controllability.estimand: same-initial-history, deterministic zero-disturbance action-to-state response under the declared analytic transition profile

metrics.action_pair_separation_rate: fraction of covered action pairs with distinct reference transitions that remain distinguishable in predicted (x,v) response space
metrics.action_response_sign_accuracy: fraction of nonzero action-vs-neutral state-response components with the correct sign
metrics.action_response_vector_mae: mean absolute error of predicted versus reference action-vs-neutral (delta_x, delta_v) response components
metrics.neutral_input_drift_energy: squared state residual from the analytic passive transition under the canonical zero-force/zero-grip command
metrics.multi_step_response_mae: mean state-component error over four autoregressive repeated-action steps, comparing predicted and analytic trajectories
metrics.prediction_coverage: fraction of the canonical action bank with a candidate branch-state prediction
metrics.multi_step_action_coverage: fraction of the canonical action bank with a complete four-step predicted trajectory

reporting.unsupported_actions: report coverage and abstention; do not treat missing action predictions as zero error
reporting.oracle_role: evaluator-only exact analytic control; not a deployable model

action_controllability.claim_ceiling: A pass validates these diagnostics against the declared analytic synthetic transition only. It does not establish physical vehicle dynamics, real-world action controllability, safety or SOTA.
